issues.text: OptimizedCursorPaginator's get_item_key uses integer-key math (math.floor/math.ceil) but is applied to a -datetime ordering, so any request against an organization that has audit log entries raises a TypeError and returns 500.
issues.zh: OptimizedCursorPaginator 用整數 key 的 get_item_key 掛在 -datetime 上，只要有資料就必定 500

issues.text: organization_context.member can be None, but line 71 dereferences it unconditionally on every request (not just the new optimized path), so callers authenticated via org auth token (who have no membership) get an AttributeError/500 on the pre-existing DateTimePaginator path too.
issues.zh: organization_context.member 可能為 None，第 71 行無條件解參照，且這行在所有請求上都會執行

issues.text: A negative offset is passed directly into a Django QuerySet slice; Django raises ValueError for negative slice bounds instead of "automatically handling" it as the code's comment claims, so a crafted cursor triggers an unhandled 500.
issues.zh: 負 offset 直接丟進 QuerySet 切片：Django 會拋 ValueError，不是註解說的「自動處理」

issues.text: enable_advanced is not the "authorized administrators" check its comment claims: it reads OrganizationMember.has_global_access (defaults to True, never set False anywhere in the repo) and request.user.is_superuser (a raw DB flag, not the codebase's is_active_superuser(request) used two lines away for the same endpoint), so the gate is true for nearly anyone who can reach the handler.
issues.zh: enable_advanced 不是它註解宣稱的「authorized administrators」判定，實務上幾乎恆真

issues.text: The change to BasePaginator.get_result affects every paginator subclass site-wide, and the negative-offset fix is only half done: the is_prev branch still passes an unclamped negative offset straight into the queryset slice, a nearby elif still compares against the un-clamped offset (risking future desync), and invalid input silently becomes "return page one" instead of the explicit error every other paginator in this codebase gives.
issues.zh: 改動 BasePaginator.get_result 會影響所有繼承者，且只修了一半：is_prev 路徑仍把負 offset 原樣送進切片

issues.text: None of the three changes in this PR — the new paginator class, the new public query parameter, and the change to shared base-class pagination behavior — have any test coverage.
issues.zh: 新 paginator、新查詢參數、共用基底行為變更，三者都沒有任何測試

issues.text: OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result duplicates almost the entire ~60-line body of BasePaginator.get_result, with the only real difference being the negative-offset branch, so future fixes to the base class won't propagate to it.
issues.zh: OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result 幾乎整段複製 BasePaginator.get_result

issues.text: Multiple comments and docstrings assert safety/ORM-behavior conclusions ("this is safe because the queryset will handle boundary conditions", "Django properly handles negative slicing automatically", "safe because permissions are checked at the queryset level", "advanced pagination features for authorized administrators") that do not match what the code actually does.
issues.zh: 註解與 docstring 對安全性與 ORM 行為下了與程式不符的結論

issues.text: Trailing whitespace, a blank line at end-of-file, and three consecutive blank lines are present in the diff and will fail the project's pre-commit checks (black + flake8).
issues.zh: 行尾空白、檔尾空行、連續三個空行，專案 pre-commit 會擋下

issues.text: The new optimized_pagination query parameter bypasses the endpoint's existing AuditLogQueryParamSerializer and is compared with a case-sensitive == "true", so values like True/1/yes silently fail to enable the feature with no error surfaced to the caller.
issues.zh: optimized_pagination 繞過既有的 query param serializer，且大小寫敏感比對會靜默失效

open_questions.text: Which specific slow query is this "performance optimization" meant to fix? There is no benchmark, profiling output, issue link, or EXPLAIN in the diff, and the existing DateTimePaginator is already keyset-paginated, so the new offset-based path could plausibly be slower, not faster.
open_questions.zh: 這次「效能最佳化」實際要解的是哪一個慢查詢？

open_questions.text: What calling pattern and return value was the negative-offset branch meant to support — reverse pagination (which the codebase already provides via cursor.is_prev) or reading past normal pagination bounds? The comments claim both, but as written the code delivers neither.
open_questions.zh: 負 offset 分支預期的呼叫方式與回傳是什麼？
